title: Sine Wave Generator (Three-Phase)
text: 离散时间或连续时间三相正弦波发生器，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间。

ports.name: mag
ports.summary: 所生成三相正弦波的幅值 scalar

ports.name: ang
ports.summary: 生成的三相正弦波的相移，单位为度 scalar

ports.name: freq
ports.summary: 生成的三相正弦波的频率，单位为 Hz scalar

ports.name: wt
ports.summary: 所有三相正弦波的角度，单位为 rad vector

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
